<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Home Services Complaint Form">48531a92c3e26e10ca67153ed40131e9</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Attachment</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
  var fileName = g_form.getValue('supporting_documents'); // Replace with actual variable name

  if (!fileName) {
    g_form.showFieldMsg('supporting_documents', 'Please attach a file.', 'error');
    return false;
  }

  var allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'png', 'jpeg', 'jpg'];
  var extension = fileName.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();

  if (!allowedExtensions.includes(extension)) {
    g_form.showFieldMsg('supporting_documents', 'Only PDF, PNG, or JPEG files are allowed.', 'error');
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-12 11:54:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>15f66ff3c3a6a650ca67153ed4013192</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Attachment</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Home Services Complaint System" source="x_1777185_home_s_0">2494ce5dc3a2e610ca67153ed40131f2</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Home Services Complaint System">2494ce5dc3a2e610ca67153ed40131f2</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_15f66ff3c3a6a650ca67153ed4013192</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-14 09:05:45</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
